items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: after I went to St. Augustine underneath the direction of, uh, Edward Hampton

ctx.x: Uh, after I went to St. Augustine underneath the direction of, uh, Edward Hampton, uh, I discontinued my music lesson on Saturday because we, uh, every day, five days a week, we would rehearse the one hour in the morning. I had for now, half of the lunch period and about two hours after school. And, uh, this, this kept my lips up and, uh, kept my eyes good as far as reading is concerned. It helped me out a lot, too.
Uh, stuff like He had you there for four years or three years or how long at St. Augustine?
